_note: v5 layout variants (PRD R4/R5), derived from the APPROVED company references (config/brand_refs.json; analysis brand/reference-analysis.md). The Phase D directions were competitor-derived and are moved to the competitor archive (never read). Categories: carousel = Instagram carousel 1:1 (5-6 slides), fb_single = Facebook post 4:5, fb_ad = Facebook ad 4:5, li_single = LinkedIn post 3:4. Ids with R are founder variants (Roman by Higgsfield Soul 2.0 (his saved character)). treatment = background treatment; rotation never repeats the previous variant and never uses one treatment three times in a row on a platform. The image model draws the picture only (designer prompt: config/designer_prompts.json); the app draws the exact German text, the official logo and the website. Built by the v5 run 2026-10-19. v6 (PRD R3.2, R3.5): bases are the sampled midnight navy (feed: bg_dark + vignette + glow) and pure black (carousels: bg_black with a dot grid, edge arcs and a particle wave), panels the sampled panel navy with a glowing outline and one cut corner, the CTA a wide dark button with its icon clear of the text, the carousel's last slide the emblem + wordmark and the LIKEN/TEILEN/SPEICHERN bar; the Light Sweep variants are dark; Roman's founder layouts carry no logo and no website (R4.6); decorations = the sets a variation adds (content/design_variation.py).

contentTypes.service_intro: introduce a service or what Branded Genius builds
contentTypes.capabilities: what a service can do, as 3-6 concrete capabilities
contentTypes.risk: a risk or the cost of doing nothing
contentTypes.myth: a common belief that is wrong
contentTypes.process: how something works, step by step
contentTypes.onboarding: how working with Branded Genius starts
contentTypes.overview: a complete system or service at a glance
contentTypes.news: a news item and why it matters
contentTypes.tool_breakdown: one tool or system explained over several slides
contentTypes.founder_story: Roman at work, behind the scenes

consistent: brand.json colour tokens only (Royal Blue, Sky Blue, Medium Gray, White)
brand fonts (Futura, Jost fallback): at most 2 type families
the official logo file, placed by code with its clear space and minimum width
64 px minimum margin at 1080 px width
one accent colour per post (Sky Blue)
noText: no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no labels, no UI, no charts, no screens, no logos, no signage, no documents, no placeholder boxes

roman._note: v6: the approved real photos of Roman in the identity set, used only for the identity sheet of the person check (never as a final image, never sent to a model). The LoRA prompt pools are archived (docs/history/README.md). minFontPx (Phase 3, P3-R1, 2026-10-22): the readable floor of the founder overlays per text role, px at 1080 px width (body text readable on a phone); a layout's textLimits minFontPx is raised to it, never lowered; copy that does not fit at the floor is 'text too long'.
roman.photoNotes: approvedPhotos: real green-screen selfies of Roman. 1, 3, 7 and 8 look like the same session but are not named; 10-14 look AI-generated and are never used. Real photos are identity references only (the identity sheet at the person check): every image of Roman is generated by Higgsfield Soul 2.0, never a real photo as the final image. portraitPhotos is unused (kept empty).
